proposals.before: In the first year of Tongzhi he followed Guoquan’s victorious drive along the Yangtze strongholds toward Jiangning, helped capture Zhenjiang, and took Moling Pass, earning nomination as regional commander.
proposals.after: In the first year of Tongzhi he followed Guoquan’s victorious drive along the Yangtze strongholds toward Jiangning, jointly took Danyang Town, and seized Moling Pass, earning nomination as regional commander.
proposals.reason: Chinese 丹陽鎮 is Danyang Town near Jiangning, not Zhenjiang (鎮江).

proposals.before: In the first year of Tongzhi, following Guoquan in pressing the advantage down the Yangtze’s fortified towns and passes and advancing on Jiangning, Chendian jointly took Zhenjiang and seized Moling Pass, and was recorded by name as a regional commander.
proposals.after: In the first year of Tongzhi, following Guoquan in pressing the advantage down the Yangtze’s fortified towns and passes and advancing on Jiangning, Chendian jointly took Danyang Town and seized Moling Pass, and was recorded by name as a regional commander.
proposals.reason: Chinese 會取丹陽鎮 refers to Danyang Town, not Zhenjiang.

proposals.before: The navy captured Taiping and Wuhu, broke Jingzhu Pass and East Liang Mountain, then took Moling Pass and Jiangxin Isle; riding the momentum they pressed Jiangning, and Fusi was nominated provincial commander-in-chief.
proposals.after: The navy captured Taiping and Wuhu, broke Jinzhu Pass and East Liang Mountain, then took Moling Pass and Jiangxin Isle; riding the momentum they pressed Jiangning, and Fusi was nominated provincial commander-in-chief.
proposals.reason: 金柱關 is Jinzhu Pass; Jingzhu misreads 金.

proposals.before: The naval force took Taiping and Wuhu, broke Jingzhu Pass and East Liang Mountain, advanced to take Moling Pass and Jiangxin Isle, pressed the advantage against Jiangning, and he was recorded by name as provincial commander-in-chief.
proposals.after: The naval force took Taiping and Wuhu, broke Jinzhu Pass and East Liang Mountain, advanced to take Moling Pass and Jiangxin Isle, pressed the advantage against Jiangning, and he was recorded by name as provincial commander-in-chief.
proposals.reason: 金柱關 is Jinzhu Pass; Jingzhu misreads 金.

proposals.before: The rebels struck at night and wrecked the gun platform; Deputy Commander Chen Wansheng fell. Next day the combined force pressed the wall; Regional Commanders Guo Pengcheng and Wang Shaoyi were killed by shellfire in turn.
proposals.after: The rebels struck at night and wrecked the gun platform; Brigade Commander Chen Wansheng fell. Next day the combined force pressed the wall; Regional Commanders Guo Pengcheng and Wang Shaoyi were killed by shellfire in turn.
proposals.reason: 副將 is rendered brigade commander for the same office later (s0079); Deputy Commander mismatches that office.

proposals.before: Li Xiucheng hid in a private house; Fusi tracked him down and took him, along with Hong Rendeng.
proposals.after: Li Xiucheng hid in a private house; Fusi tracked him down and took him, along with Hong Renda.
proposals.reason: 洪仁達 is Hong Renda; Rendeng does not match 仁達.

proposals.before: Li Xiucheng hid in a civilian house; Fusi searched him out and captured him, and also seized Hong Rendeng.
proposals.after: Li Xiucheng hid in a civilian house; Fusi searched him out and captured him, and also seized Hong Renda.
proposals.reason: 洪仁達 is Hong Renda, not Rendeng.

proposals.before: Jiangxi paid no rations; Zhang Fei, shielded in southern Anhui, supplied the funds that kept the army from breaking up.
proposals.after: Jiangxi paid no rations; Zhang Fu, shielded in southern Anhui, supplied the funds that kept the army from breaking up.
proposals.reason: 張芾 is Zhang Fu; Zhang Fei confuses a different historical name.

proposals.before: Jiangxi did not provide pay; Zhang Fei, relying on his screen in southern Anhui, supplied funds, and only then did the army not disperse.
proposals.after: Jiangxi did not provide pay; Zhang Fu, relying on his screen in southern Anhui, supplied funds, and only then did the army not disperse.
proposals.reason: 張芾 is Zhang Fu, not Zhang Fei.

proposals.before: Guofan held him in high regard and recommended him for civil office, to be posted as county magistrate when a vacancy opened in Jiangxi.
proposals.after: Zeng Guofan held him in high regard and recommended him for civil office, to be posted as county magistrate when a vacancy opened in Jiangxi.
proposals.reason: Chinese names 曾國籓 in full; the idiomatic English first mention drops the surname Zeng.

proposals.before: He followed Guoquan in capturing Ji'an, was made subprefect, and went to Anhui to help suppress the rebels; in the tenth year he won a great victory at Xiaochi Post Station and was promoted to prefect.
proposals.after: He followed Zeng Guoquan in capturing Ji'an, was made subprefect, and went to Anhui to help suppress the rebels; in the tenth year he won a great victory at Xiaochi Post Station and was promoted to prefect.
proposals.reason: Chinese first mention is 曾國荃; idiomatic English uses only Guoquan.

proposals.before: When the main force closed on Jiangning, Yuju and the other commanders took separate routes to seize Zhenjiang, Moling Pass, and other strongpoints, leveling dozens of rebel forts before assaulting the stone citadel at Yuhuatai, which the rebels held at all costs and would not yield.
proposals.after: When the main force closed on Jiangning, Yuju and the other commanders took separate routes to seize Danyang Town, Moling Pass, and other strongpoints, leveling dozens of rebel forts before assaulting the stone citadel at Yuhuatai, which the rebels held at all costs and would not yield.
proposals.reason: 丹陽鎮 is Danyang Town near Jiangning, not Zhenjiang (鎮江).

proposals.before: As the main army pressed Jiangning, Yuju with the various generals took separate routes to capture Zhenjiang, Moling Pass, and other key passes, leveled dozens of rebel forts, and advanced against the stone fortress at Yuhuatai; the rebels fought to the death and it was not taken.
proposals.after: As the main army pressed Jiangning, Yuju with the various generals took separate routes to capture Danyang Town, Moling Pass, and other key passes, leveled dozens of rebel forts, and advanced against the stone fortress at Yuhuatai; the rebels fought to the death and it was not taken.
proposals.reason: Literal English likewise renders 丹陽鎮 as Zhenjiang.

proposals.before: In the sixth year he passed to Guoquan's command, captured Anfu, and fought at Ji'an.
proposals.after: In the sixth year he was transferred to Zeng Guoquan's army, captured Anfu, and fought at Ji'an.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic 'passed to Guoquan's command' both weakens 改隸 and drops the surname 曾 present in the Chinese and the literal line.

proposals.before: Guofan memorialized that in the recovery of Jiangning Shiri had held the northwest sector, ranking in merit after Li Chendian, Liu Lianjie, and Xiao Fusi; the court granted generous posthumous honors and the name Qinwu.
proposals.after: Guofan memorialized that in the recovery of Jiangning, Shiri had held the northwest sector, ranking in merit after Li Chendian, Liu Lianjie, and Xiao Fusi; the court granted generous posthumous honors and the name Qinwu.
proposals.reason: Missing comma after Jiangning fuses the place and the person into a single English phrase and obscures that Shiri is the subject of the memorial.

proposals.before: He then served under Guoquan, captured Ji'an and Anqing, rose to brigade commander, and received the title Zhuyong Batulu.
proposals.after: He then served under Zeng Guoquan, captured Ji'an and recaptured Anqing, rose to brigade commander, and received the title Zhuyong Batulu.
proposals.reason: Chinese 嗣從曾國荃 names Zeng Guoquan in full, and 復安慶 means Anqing was taken again, which the idiomatic rendering drops.

proposals.before: In the first year of Tongzhi he followed Guoquan down the Yangtze, capturing one stronghold after another with outstanding merit, rose to deputy commander, and received the title Ziyong Batulu.
proposals.after: In the first year of Tongzhi he followed Zeng Guoquan down the Yangtze, capturing one stronghold after another with outstanding merit, rose to deputy commander, and received the title Ziyong Batulu.
proposals.reason: Chinese 從曾國荃 has the full name Zeng Guoquan; the idiomatic shortening to Guoquan is unclear in this chunk.

proposals.before: The historians remark: Hong Xiuquan had held Jiangning for more than a decade when Guoquan, before Jiangsu and Zhejiang were pacified, struck in with a single army—a vast city, massive relief, and odds as hard as they come.
proposals.after: The historians remark: Hong Xiuquan had held Jiangning for more than a decade when Zeng Guoquan, before Jiangsu and Zhejiang were pacified, struck in with a single army—a vast city, massive relief, and odds as hard as they come.
proposals.reason: Chinese 曾國荃 is the full name; idiomatic Guoquan is opaque without the prior surname.

decisions.reason: s0011 has 會取丹陽鎮, 奪秣陵關, not 鎮江. Zhenjiang is a different place; Danyang Town matches the Chinese, and jointly took / seized tracks 會取 and 奪.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 臣典會取丹陽鎮，奪秣陵關

decisions.reason: The literal line likewise turns 丹陽鎮 into Zhenjiang. The source names Danyang Town.
s0047 has 破金柱關. 金 is Jin, not Jing; Jingzhu Pass is a misreading of the first character.
The literal field has the same Jingzhu error for 金柱關.
副將 is already rendered Deputy Commander in nearby s0012 (副將倪桂節). The proposed Brigade Commander is a stylistic alignment with later units, not a meaning error.
s0059 names 洪仁達. 達 is da; Rendeng invents a different given name.
The literal field repeats Hong Rendeng for 洪仁達; Hong Renda is the matching romanization.
s0072 names 張芾. Zhang Fei is 張飛, another person; 芾 is Fu.
The literal field likewise gives Zhang Fei for 張芾.
Guofan is the given name of 曾國籓 and is unambiguous in this chapter’s idiomatic style, which already uses Guoquan without the surname. Restoring Zeng is stylistic, not a semantic error.
s0108’s 從曾國荃 is already rendered as followed Guoquan, matching the chapter’s given-name idiom (as in s0011). The full surname is a style preference.
s0129 lists 丹陽鎮、秣陵關諸要隘. Zhenjiang (鎮江) is not in the Chinese.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 分路取丹陽鎮、秣陵關諸要隘

decisions.reason: The literal field makes the same Zhenjiang substitution for 丹陽鎮.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 取丹陽鎮、秣陵關諸要隘

decisions.reason: 改隸曾國荃軍 is adequately given as passed to Guoquan’s command. Adding Zeng and rewriting transferred to … army is a stylistic tightening, not a factual correction.
The original already means that in recovering Jiangning, Shiri held the northwest sector. The added comma is punctuation polish, not a meaning repair.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 疏陳詩日克復江寧，當西北一路

decisions.after: He then served under Guoquan, captured Ji'an and recaptured Anqing, rose to brigade commander, and received the title Zhuyong Batulu.
decisions.reason: 復安慶 is recapture, which the original omits. The bundled insertion of Zeng is unnecessary given the chapter’s given-name idiom; keep Guoquan and restore recaptured.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 嗣從曾國荃，克吉安，復安慶

decisions.reason: 從曾國荃 is already followed Guoquan. Expanding the surname in this chunk is stylistic.
The commentary’s 曾國荃 is the same Guoquan used throughout the chapter. Prefixing Zeng does not correct an error.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 曾國荃於蘇、浙未定之先，孤軍直搗

claimRevisions.reason: The extracted English name Hong Rendeng was produced by the mistranslation of 洪仁達; the person remains attested, so the name value is corrected to Hong Renda.
The extracted English name Zhang Fei was produced by the mistranslation of 張芾; the person remains attested, so the name value is corrected to Zhang Fu.
